title: Event Log Filtering Fails - Account Activity Tools
problem: failedLogons, successfulLogons tools fail to query security events. Get-WinEvent with ID filters fails silently or returns empty
evidence: Pattern: All event log queries with specific event IDs fail
cause: Security event log access requires elevated privileges OR filter hashtable syntax incompatible with current PowerShell context

recommended_actions.action: Check for SeSecurityPrivilege requirement and add fallback if missing
Use Get-EventLog as alternative to Get-WinEvent for Security log

notes: Pattern: Affects 3+ tools (failedLogons, successfulLogons, loggedOnUsers). Similar root cause as IC-002/IC-006/IC-008.
